'''War Centers''' were military facilities used to research warfare technology, such as more accurate and powerful weapons, or increased unit armor. They were produced by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] or organic workers such as [[Glurrg]]s or [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] at a cost of 180 units of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] all used their own version of War Centers.

An Imperial war center was located in close proximity to the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], along with a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] and [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]].

==Behind the scenes==
War Centers appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]].
